meta.title: SSO / SAML 2.0: on failure — SSO errors logged
gaps: Configure the SSO/SAML 2.0 integration and its parameters on the tenant.
Make the external SSO provider fail or become unreachable.
Trigger a Procol login through SSO and observe the failure handling.
Inspect the relevant state, alert, log, or retry record to verify that the SSO error was logged and not silently dropped.
